in_marathi.name: Shera
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shera हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shera is a Sanskrit and Hindi name which means 'lioness'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shri', meaning 'goddess of wealth and prosperity', and the Sanskrit word 'ra', meaning 'king'. This name embodies the strength and courage of a lioness, as well as the feminine energy of a goddess.
